key_insight: Kriging and neural-network models can predict pressure losses across perforated plates more accurately than traditional empirical formulas in turbulent flow.
engineering_relevance: These data-driven surrogates are suitable for CFD/RANS simulations because they can be embedded as source terms to model perforated-plate losses in practical engineering flows.
method: Trained two separate models: kriging and neural networks.
Used two experimental datasets from the literature covering circular perforations in turbulent flow.
Benchmarked predictions against common empirical correlations and tested in 2D RANS channel-flow simulations.
evidence_signal: Across the available experimental configurations, both models generally matched measured pressure losses well and outperformed widely used empirical formulae.
watch_item: Performance may be limited by the small, literature-based training dataset, so extrapolation to unseen plate geometries or flow conditions should be used cautiously.
paper_title: Kriging and neural network models for pressure losses across perforated plates
